Each receipt seconds value covers that task call only; summing overlapping task times is not elapsed phase wall time. Whole-run wall time includes preparation, pool startup, checkpoint serialization, parent collection and validation.

peak_rss_bytes is getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss for the worker lifetime, not private memory newly allocated by that task. It includes inherited/shared pages and previous work; sums of such peaks do not measure concurrent physical RAM.
The projection deliberately counts inherited parent pages in every worker. It is a conservative allocation check, not an observed resident-memory total.
The mutable in-run BUDGET-CHECKPOINT records parent plus reaped child CPU. Its last pre-reap114.025278539 value is not the final run CPU; final RUN records1216.10677938 after pool termination/join.
No current machine load, cgroup throttling or free-memory conclusion is inferred; root is collecting those live measurements separately.
